newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Crepe prices ease at Colombo rubber auction.
newsitem.headline: Crepe prices ease at Colombo rubber auction.

text.p: Crepe prices eased at Thursday's Colombo rubber auction as bigger quantities came on the market following good weather, brokers and exporters said.

"The weather has improved and quantities are coming in so prices came down," said an exporter. "People are in no hurry to buy because they expect more rubber on the market now the weather has improved."

The average price for best latex one-x was 72.50 rupees ($1.28) per kg, down a rupee from Tuesday's auction. Number one was at 71 rupees from 72.50 on Tuesday, while RSS 1, unquoted on Tuesday, was at 62.75 rupees.
